slides.headline: ONE LINK PUTS YOUR ENTIRE BOT IN ANYONE'S HANDS
slides.body: A business owner built a Grok Bot that answered every FAQ her team asked daily. She shared one link. All 12 team members ran the same trained agent within the hour, no setup needed.

slides.headline: 1) FIND YOUR SHARE LINK IN THE THREE-DOT MENU
slides.body: Open Grok on X → tap your Bot's profile → tap the three-dot menu → select "Share Bot Design"

slides.headline: 2) KNOW WHAT RECIPIENTS CAN AND CANNOT DO
slides.body: One agency shared their client-intake bot with 50 clients in a single day. None could alter the agent's training. Your persona, system prompt, and rules stay locked to you alone.

slides.headline:
SHARE IT.
STILL OWN IT.
slides.body: The creator is always the owner. Update your bot after sharing and every existing link reflects the new version. Delete it and every link goes dead. You never lose the keys

slides.headline: 3) UPDATE OR DELETE YOUR BOT ANYTIME AFTER SHARING
slides.body: A freelancer updated her intake bot's tone mid-month. Every person who already had the link got the new version instantly, no resend needed. Delete the bot and all share links die at once.

slides.headline: 4) FOLLOW THESE RULES WHEN YOU USE SOMEONE ELSE'S BOT
slides.body: When you open a shared bot, you will not see the full instructions, just the behavior they built. Do not extract their prompt or clone their design. X's terms cover it.

slides.headline: 5) NEVER SHARE A BOT BUILT FOR THESE THINGS
slides.body: X removes bots built to impersonate real people, generate spam, or break platform rules. When a bot gets pulled, every share link dies at once, one violation erases your entire distribution.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: 5 GROK BOT SHARING RULES
slides.body:
1) Share link: three-dot menu
2) Recipients cannot edit your bot
3) Update or delete, all links change
4) Don't clone another creator's design
5) No spam bots, X kills every link

caption:
Swipe through all 5 rules before you share your first Grok Bot with anyone. 🤖

The second slide on how one link puts your trained bot in an entire team's hands instantly, Rule 1 where the share link actually lives inside your bot's menu, Rule 2 on what recipients can and cannot touch once they have the link, the control break showing you keep full ownership even after sharing, Rule 3 on how updates and deletions hit every existing link in real time, Rule 4 on how to use someone else's bot without violating their design, Rule 5 on the bot types X removes along with every share link they ever generated

Grok Bots are the first AI agents most people will share with a team or hand to customers with no code at all. The rules around sharing decide whether your bot reaches hundreds of people or gets pulled in the first week. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.
